set.body:
Scope: Remaining surface/hybrid projection/resampling, spatial compilers/runtimes and IO adapters; neurosurf4s optional integration modules.

Deliverable: Move surface execution over mesh/core contracts, and volume-to-surface projection/hybrid routing over neuroim4s where neuroimaging policy is required. Keep pure image4s-based sampling direct where sufficient. Atlas routes stay above this layer; functional/latent response composition stays in ScalaFIM.

Acceptance:
- Surface-only operations do not force a volume runtime; projection/hybrid modules declare their image/transform dependencies explicitly.
- Shared world/domain identity, projection/backprojection, route direction, field order and scoped/materialization fixtures pass on JVM/JS.
- No reverse dependency into either image or surface core and no permanent mixed-spatial runtime copy remain; generic kernels stay provider-owned.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U5: Extract optional surface and volume-surface spatial execution
